This draft needs confirmed business contacts and operating details, plus legal review, before public launch or customer onboarding.

Who these terms cover

This website is presented by Nile Africa Technologies Ltd., Nigeria, under the Sena brand. These draft terms describe use of the informational website and its demonstrations. They are not an executed subscription agreement, service-level agreement or data processing agreement.

Website and product demonstrations

Use the website for lawful information and evaluation purposes. Product screens, reservation data, room statuses and portfolio figures shown here are illustrative. Interacting with a preview does not create an account, a hotel reservation, a payment, or an appointment.

Features, plan limits and integration availability may change. A live subscription should begin only after the parties agree the applicable order, service scope and subscription terms.

Pricing and onboarding

Prices are stated in Nigerian naira. The pricing page currently presents monthly and annual subscription options and a separate onboarding charge for the Essential plan. Your order should confirm the selected plan, billing period, onboarding scope, taxes where applicable, payment dates and total payable before purchase.

Sena’s standard plan proposition does not include a percentage commission on direct reservations. Payment provider, channel and other third-party fees can still apply. A displayed price is not a promise that every feature or integration is available for every property.

Renewal, cancellation and refunds

No subscription purchases or automatic renewals take place through this website preview. Renewal arrangements, how to cancel, the effective cancellation date, export and deletion arrangements, and any refund entitlement must be disclosed and agreed before a live subscription begins. This draft does not create a blanket no-refund policy.

Nothing in these terms excludes mandatory statutory rights or remedies. Guest stay cancellations and refunds are handled under the hospitality operator’s booking terms and applicable payment provider rules; they are separate from Sena subscription billing.

Your responsibilities

You must have authority to act for any business you represent. Do not use the site to impersonate someone, submit information you are not entitled to share, interfere with its operation or attempt unauthorised access. See the Acceptable use policy.

Live account access, staff permissions, protection of credentials and the lawful handling of guest information must be addressed in the service agreement.

Third-party services

Payment providers, distribution channels and linked services operate under their own terms and privacy notices. Sena is software, not the hotel providing a guest’s stay or the payment provider processing funds. Integration availability depends on provider, market and connection requirements.

Intellectual property

The Sena name, supplied brand assets, website design and software are owned by or licensed to the relevant rights holders. You may view the website and share links for legitimate evaluation. Do not claim ownership of Sena’s brand or redistribute its software without permission. Third-party names and marks belong to their respective owners.

Availability and responsibility

We aim to keep website information useful and accurate, but it may contain errors or become outdated. Access may be interrupted for maintenance, faults or security reasons. Confirm material product and commercial details before relying on them.

No service uptime commitment or contractual liability cap is established by this preview. Nothing here excludes responsibility that cannot lawfully be excluded, or removes rights available under applicable Nigerian law.

Governing law and enquiries

These website terms are intended to be governed by Nigerian law, subject to any mandatory protections that apply. Parties should first seek to resolve concerns in good faith, without restricting access to a competent court or regulator.

The public legal contact email and registered address are awaiting confirmation from Nile Africa Technologies Ltd. These draft terms require completion and legal review before public launch.
